newsitem.title: UK: British Land yr pretax profits up 47 pct.
newsitem.headline: British Land yr pretax profits up 47 pct.

text.p: An expansion in its property portfolio pushed up pretax profits of British Land Co Plc by 47 percent to 91.2 million pounds ($149.3 million) from 62.1 million in the year to March, 1997, the company said on Wednesday.
It said its net assets per share were up 14.3 percent to 487 pence per share from 426 pence. Its earnings per share was ahead at 15.7 pence against 11.2 in the previous year.
The company's pretax profits exceeded analysts' expectations which ranged between 75 and 79 million pounds.
The company offered a final dividend of 6.08 pence per share which along with an interim of 2.92 pence made it a total dividend of nine pence a share, against last year's 8.55 pence.
The company's share price held firm at 588 pence, up 1/2 pence, in early morning trade.
British Land, a major player in the country's commercial property market which is currently on a recovery path after a slump in the early 1990s, saw its gross assets rising to 4.9 billion pounds.
The company's total properties including its share in joint ventures rose to 5.1 billion pounds, it said. ($ = 0.610 British Pounds).
